summary.name: cmux
summary.one_liner: cmux is an open source native macOS terminal built on Ghostty, designed for running and managing multiple coding agents with vertical tabs, attention notifications, split panes, and a CLI.
use_cases: Running multiple Claude Code or Codex sessions side by side
Getting alerted when a coding agent needs attention
Letting AI agents control the browser and create terminals via CLI
Building custom agent harnesses and orchestrators
Organizing terminal work into vertical tabs and split panes
summary.what_it_does: cmux is a native macOS terminal written in Swift/AppKit and built on Ghostty. It offers vertical tabs, split panes, and workspaces for organizing terminal sessions. Panes that need attention get highlighted with blue notification rings, which is aimed at agent workflows. It includes a built-in browser and a CLI that lets coding agents control the browser, create new workspaces, and start other agents in new terminals.
notable: Built on Ghostty, with a native Swift/AppKit implementation
CLI lets coding agents drive the browser and terminals
Blue notification rings flag panes that need attention
Licensed AGPL and free to use
caveats: Native macOS only; no other platforms are named on the page
The page is a Y Combinator company listing that is largely promotional; hiring details (roles, salary ranges) are not relevant to the tool itself
